query_text: Where can I download the latest version of Python?

message.content:
You can download the latest version of Python from the **official Python website**:

**https://www.python.org/downloads/**

This is the safest and most reliable source for downloading Python. When you visit the page, the website will automatically detect your operating system and display a prominent button to download the latest stable release (currently Python 3.13.x as of the search results).

### Alternative download options:
- **Microsoft Store**: Python is also available on the Microsoft Store for Windows users, which offers convenient automatic updates
- **Package managers**: 
  - On Linux (RHEL/CentOS): You can install Python 3.13 via EPEL repository using `sudo dnf install python3.13`
  - On Windows: You can use winget or other package managers

### Installation tips:
- Always download from the official website to avoid counterfeit or outdated versions
- During installation on Windows, make sure to **check the box "Add Python to PATH"** for easier command-line access
- Choose the installer that matches your system architecture (64-bit recommended for most modern systems)

Sources:
1. https://www.python.org/downloads/
2. http://geekchamp.com/how-to-download-python-on-windows-11-a-step-by-step-installation-guide
3. https://wingetgui.com/apps/Python-Python-3-13
4. https://developers.redhat.com/articles/2025/09/22/install-python-313-red-hat-enterprise-linux-epel
5. https://python.p2hp.com/downloads/
6. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/how-to-update-python-on-windows/
